mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.lead_id, l.display_name as lead_name, o.product_code, o.product_name, o.amount, o.currency, o.status, o.pay_method, o.pay_note, o.paid_time, o.confirmed_by, o.cancel_reason, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.remark from abr_order o left join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = o.lead_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_order (order_no, lead_id, product_code, product_name, amount, currency, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{orderNo}, #{leadId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{amount}, coalesce(#{currency}, 'CNY'), 'pending', #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_order set status = 'paid', pay_method = #{payMethod}, pay_note = coalesce(#{payNote}, ''), paid_time = now(), confirmed_by = #{operator}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'pending'
update abr_order set status = #{to}, cancel_reason = #{reason}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = #{from}
